31.58818,74.31559: Diwan-e-aam or hall of public audience was constructed during the time of Shah Jahan in 1631-32 A.D. It has 40 pillars and stands on a large raised rectangular platform measuring 187x60 It is a large front court of the Daulat Khana-e-Khas-O-Aam
31.58935,74.31291: Shah Burj Gate Built by Shah Jahan in 1631-32 A.D. this magnificent gate was used exclusively by the royalty. An inscription in Persian records its completion in the 4th regnal year of Shah Jahan under supervision of Mamur Khan
31.58944,74.31242: Hathi Paer (Elephant Path) Built by Shah Jahan in 1631-32 A.D. the stairs case consisting of 58 low and broad steps provided aceess to the Royalty mounted on elephants from Shah Burj to the forecourt of the Shish Mahal
31.58975,74.31343: Shish Mahal Shish Mahal (Palace of Mirrors) was built by Asif Khan the then Governor of Lahore for Emperor Shah Jahan in 1631-32 AD. It is a most decorated place in the fort, embelished with mirror work, stucco tracery, guild work pietra dura work and fret work in marble etc. Palace consists of a spacious lofty hall with several rooms behind and on either sides and a vast courtyard in front. Naulakha pavilion, famous for its minute and delicate pietra dura work lies in the north west corner of the courtyard. The semiprecious stones used in the pietra dura work include agate, jade, lapis lazuli. Variety of varigated marbles i.e. sang-e-badal, sang-e-abri, sang-e-musa, sang-e-khattu are used in flooring
